title: Mansi Falls to Xu Wen Jing in Indonesia Masters Super 100 Final
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Mansi reached the final of the Indonesia Masters Super 100, showcasing her potential on the international stage.
summary: World No. 76 Mansi lost to China's Xu Wen Jing 16-21, 8-21 in the Indonesia Masters Super 100 women's singles final, concluding her strong run in the tournament.

title: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty Storm into China Masters Final
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, have secured their spot in a major final, aiming for another title this year.
summary: India's star men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, defeated their Malaysian rivals in three games to reach their third China Masters final, eyeing their second title of the year.

title: Fit-Again Sable Believes He is Back to His Best
indian_angle: Indian steeplechaser Sable's return to form after a 14-month layoff is a positive sign for Indian athletics.
summary: The Indian steeplechaser Sable, who endured self-doubt and emotional turmoil during a 14-month layoff, now believes he is back to his best form.

title: Indian Women Hammer Malaysia, Men Draw Japan in Jr Asia Cup
indian_angle: The Indian women's team delivered a dominant performance, while the men's team secured a draw against Japan in the Jr Asia Cup, highlighting India's presence in the tournament.
summary: The Indian women's team secured a decisive victory against Malaysia, while the men's team was held to a draw by Japan in their respective Jr Asia Cup matches today.
